text:
<subject>Re: Our luncheon</subject>
<body>
Laura,

Ronald is with Highland Equity. Can you coordinate with him on the final attendee count as the date approaches? Thanks!
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Ronald Prince <ronald.prince@highlandcapital.com>
Sent: Friday, May 3, 2024 6:29 AM
To: Bonnie Gardner <bonnie.gardner@cedarpointcap.com>
Subject: Re: Our luncheon

Bonnie,

The Crestview Conference Room works well for everyone who has replied so far. I’m waiting on the rest of the invitees and will update you on the exact head count once I have all responses.

Apologies for the delay,
Ronald

-----Original Message-----
From: Bonnie Gardner <bonnie.gardner@cedarpointcap.com>
Sent: Thursday, May 2, 2024 8:43 AM
To: Ronald Prince <ronald.prince@highlandcapital.com>
Cc: Connie Sutton <connie.sutton@cedarpointcap.com>, Christina Bell <christina.bell@cedarpointcap.com>
Subject: Our luncheon

Ronald,

You haven’t confirmed if this date works and the total head count. Please confirm. Thanks.

-----Original Message-----
From: Bonnie Gardner <bonnie.gardner@cedarpointcap.com>
Sent: Friday, April 12, 2024 4:45 PM
To: Ronald Prince <ronald.prince@highlandcapital.com>
Subject: Our luncheon

Christina Bell’s assistant reserved Crestview Conference Room on May 22 from 11:30 AM to 2:00 PM for our luncheon. Please confirm if the date works for your team and the total head count. Laura will handle lunch orders.

Thanks!
</quoted>
